description: End to end: add a CLI flag with tests in a scratch repo. With real subagents the success check runs against their work; the recorded reply makes dry runs free (G3).
prompt: In the scratch repo ~/eval/wordcount, add a --lines flag to the wc.py CLI that counts lines instead of words, with tests. pytest must pass.

replies.report: Added --lines to wc.py (argparse flag; counts newline-separated lines) and tests/test_lines.py with 4 tests. pytest: 11 passed.

arguments.brief:
## Goal
Add a --lines flag to the wc.py CLI in ~/eval/wordcount that counts lines instead of words.

## Context
wc.py uses argparse; tests live in tests/ and run with pytest from the repo root.

## Constraints
Keep the default (word count) behaviour unchanged.

## Acceptance
- `python wc.py --lines FILE` prints the line count.
- New tests cover --lines, including an empty file; pytest passes.

## Output format
Changed files, the new tests, and the pytest summary line.

reference.content: Added --lines to wc.py with 4 new tests in tests/test_lines.py; pytest: 11 passed.
